capabilities: Install bundled report templates and database views
Apply optional vault settings for editor, appearance, hotkeys, graph and core plugins
Back up and restore installed resources with journaled import
Generate writing with optional AI providers
Look up video metadata from YouTube or Bilibili
disambiguation: Not an editor or dashboard UI of its own; it installs bundled templates, views, styles and vault settings.
extras: Desktop-only; mobile compatibility not verified and a real Obsidian UI installation has not been tested. Applied settings are global to the vault and installation does not sync devices. Backups stay inside the vault, so a separate external backup is advised. Optional AI and video lookup send selected context to external services.
problem: Building a structured creator workspace in Obsidian means creating templates, views, styles and editor settings by hand, one at a time.
